description: List every maintenance window of the organization, enabled or not, in effect or not. Each has id, name, enabled, scope (ORG or MONITOR), dtstart, duration_minutes, rrule, timezone, monitor_ids and created_at. Use it to find a window's id. To learn whether alerts are silenced right now use list_active_maintenance; for a window's upcoming occurrences use get_maintenance_window. Returns a page: items plus total, page, size and pages.

q.description: Case-insensitive substring of the name, up to 255 characters.

size.description: Rows per page, 1 to 100; default 25. Keep paging until you have seen total rows.

sort.description: created_at (the default, newest first) or name.

name: list_maintenance_windows
title: List maintenance windows
